name: empty-search
title: Empty State search
description: No search results, with a way to clear the search.

files.content:
import { Component, signal } from '@angular/core'; import { NdIcon } from '@ndop/core'; import { Button } from '@/ui/button/button'; import { Empty, EmptyContent, EmptyDescription, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle, } from '@/ui/empty/empty'; /** * No search results, which says what was searched and offers to clear * the search. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-empty-search', imports: [ Button, Empty, EmptyContent, EmptyDescription, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle, NdIcon, ], template: `

No results

Nothing matches “{{ query() }}”. Check the spelling or try other words.

`, }) export class EmptySearchExample { protected readonly query = signal('quarterly report 2019'); }
